description:
A wonderful and meaningful Health & Nutrition Awareness Session was conducted today at Kapol Vidyanidhi School on the theme “Eat Like a Hero & Think Like a Champion.”

A big thank you to Rashmi Vyas, daughter of our own Rtn. Yagnesh Bhatt, for an engaging and inspiring session. The students participated with great enthusiasm and energy!

Our heartfelt thanks to PP Sunita Hirlekar and Rtn. Vikas Hirlekar for their presence and encouragement.

Another wonderful step towards nurturing healthy, confident and informed young minds.
